description: This source file provides functions to interact with a 'notes' database table via Supabase, including inserting notes, fetching notes with filters, retrieving individual notes by ID, toggling likes and bookmarks, and fetching user-specific notes.

methods.name: insertNote(payload)
methods.description: Inserts metadata for an uploaded note into the database.

methods.name: fetchNotes({ q, tag, sort = "new", limit = 12, offset = 0 })
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes with optional query parameters such as search query, tag, sort order, limit, and offset.

methods.name: fetchNoteById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID.

methods.name: toggleLike(noteId, like = true)
methods.description: Likes or unlikes a note, updating the like count naively.

methods.name: toggleBookmark(noteId, bookmark = true)
methods.description: Toggles the bookmark status of a note, updating the count naively.

methods.name: fetchUserNotes(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves all notes created by a specific user.

ctags.name: fetchNotes
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchNotes({ q, tag, sort = "new", limit = 12, offset = 0 }) {$/
